title: Social media plan
description: Plan the posts for a launch or a period: networks, messages, calendar, who answers comments and how results are measured.

inputs.label: Objective and the audience on each network
Key messages and the visuals available
Accounts that will post and who has access to them

tool_actions.description: Publishing or scheduling posts on social networks.
Replying to comments and direct messages.

sections.title: Networks and audience
sections.prompt: Why each network reaches the audience, with the evidence, and where competitors are present according to the market dossier.

sections.title: Calendar
sections.prompt: Each post with its date, network, text, visual and link.

sections.title: Moderation and replies
sections.prompt: Who answers comments, how fast, and what goes to support or legal.

sections.title: Measurement
sections.prompt: The metric per network, its baseline and how links are tagged.

checks.verification: Each claim points to evidence the team can show: a measurement, a customer result or a dated source.
Every image, video, music and quote is owned, licensed or approved for this use.
Paid partnerships and sponsored posts are labelled as such.
Tagged links and the metric per network are set up before the first post.
